binary_delegation.description: Simple yes/no decisions, failed tasks split into 2 components
binary_delegation.decision_process: Each folder asks: Can this be done as single bash command?
binary_delegation.hypothesis: Optimal for simple, linear tasks with clear pass/fail criteria

fixed_variable_delegation.description: Fixed number of components (3, 6, 12) regardless of task type
fixed_variable_delegation.decision_process: Always break into N components based on task complexity
fixed_variable_delegation.hypothesis: Optimal for tasks with known complexity patterns

adaptive_task_type_delegation.description: Number of components varies based on task classification

sequential_tasks.rationale: Sequential tasks have natural linear breakdown

parallel_tasks.rationale: Parallel tasks benefit from maximum concurrent components

hierarchical_tasks.rationale: Natural hierarchy suggests moderate branching like org charts

exploratory_tasks.rationale: Multiple approaches needed, but not overwhelming

creative_tasks.rationale: Too many options can hurt creativity (choice overload)

analytical_tasks.rationale: Systematic analysis benefits from structured breakdown

adaptive_task_type_delegation.hypothesis: Optimal branching varies significantly by task type

dynamic_complexity_delegation.description: Components determined by estimated task complexity and available resources
dynamic_complexity_delegation.branching_algorithm: ML model predicts optimal branching based on task features

complex_tasks: Implement ML pipeline with A/B testing
hybrid_tasks: Create API gateway with rate limiting

experimental_procedure.phase_1_baseline: Test all strategies on same task set
experimental_procedure.phase_3_hybrid: Test combinations of strategies for different task phases
experimental_procedure.phase_4_ml_training: Train dynamic model using results from phases 1-3
